sahneler.metin: After torrential rain, an earthen dam in Iowa failed.
Suddenly the lake behind it drained through the breach.
About ten inches of rain fell in twelve hours.
The river upstream reached record levels.
Only two of the three spillway gates were fully open.
The dam was rebuilt years later.

Delhi Dam overtopped and failed in Iowa. The cause: overtopping of an earthen embankment when spillway capacity fell short.
